title: AI Tools Pricing — plan-level row
description: Row schema for datasets/ai-tools/plans_2026.json (field `rows`), its CSV twin and datasets/ai-tools/snapshots/. Unknown values are null, never 0 or an empty string. License: CC BY-SA 4.0 — attribution required: AMPM-AIOPS 問問貓 (ampm-aiops.com)

plan_id.description: Stable identifier: <tool_slug>/<plan-slug>. Does not change when the price changes.

tool_slug.description: Tool identifier; joins to `slug` in data/ai_tools_2026.json.

plan_name.description: Plan name as listed by the vendor. null for the free-tier row when the vendor's own name for it is not recorded.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every price figure in the row.

tax_treatment.description: tax_included | tax_excluded. null = not recorded (most vendor pages do not say).

billing_period.description: monthly | annual | usage | one_time | custom_quote. null = not recorded.

price_unit.description: per_user when the price is per seat. null = flat price or not recorded.

monthly_list_price.description: List price per month when billed monthly, as read on the official page. Never derived from an annual price. null = no monthly price was read on the official page.

annual_billing_price_as_listed.description: The figure the official page shows when annual billing is selected, in the page's own unit. Not converted. null = none read.

annual_billing_price_unit.description: per_month_billed_annually | per_year. null = the unit of annual_billing_price_as_listed was not recorded.

annual_list_price_total.description: Total charged per year when billed annually. Filled only when that total itself was recorded; never computed.

free_quota_summary.description: Free-tier allowance in our own words (zh-Hant). Only on plan_type=free rows.

free_quota_summary_en.description: English version of free_quota_summary when available.

free_quota_reset_period.description: daily | weekly | monthly | none. null = not recorded.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 when the price applies to one market only. null = the vendor's default (international) price page.

eligibility.description: Who may buy the plan (students, non-profits, minimum seats ...). null = not recorded.

promo_ends.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) of a time-limited promotional price. null = no promotion recorded.

api_price_unit.description: Unit for usage-based API pricing. null = not an API unit price or not recorded.

api_unit_price.description: Price per api_price_unit. null = not recorded.

source_url.description: Official page the figures were checked against (tracking parameters stripped).

last_verified.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the check against source_url.

verification.description: price_check_ok = plan name and price matched the official page on last_verified; price_check_annual_only = only the annual figure was shown and matched; tool_level = free-tier row carried from the tool-level record.

change_type.description: price_increase / price_decrease = the previous figure matched the official page and the new one does too; correction = the previous figure had stopped matching the official page, so our record was brought back in line (the vendor may have changed the price earlier).

field.description: price = the plan's main published figure; annual_billing_price = the figure shown under annual billing.

detected_on.description: Day our published figure changed (YYYY-MM-DD). Not necessarily the day the vendor changed it.

previous_value_matched_official_page.description: false = the previous figure no longer matched the official page at its last check, so this entry may be a late correction rather than a same-day vendor change.

legacy_tool_row.description: Row of data/ai_tools_2026.json (field `tools`) — unchanged tool-level file, kept for existing users.
